doc: A PROPERTY case (it never calls _random_rotation: the function field has the prefix property.; a port checks its own drawn rotations against the same two outputs). The 48 octave rotations recorded from two fbm calls (24 octaves each, seeds 101 and 102; float32, the inputs) are orthonormal with determinant +1: rot rot^T equals the identity and det(rot) = 1, both computed here in float64 from the float32 matrices (so they deviate by the float32 rounding: 7.3e-8 in the Gram matrix, 6.9e-8 in the determinant; the expected outputs are the identity and 1 to within 1e-6). A port that draws its own rotations must satisfy the same two outputs on them.

params.source: plan1.rot of two 24-octave fbm calls (seeds 101, 102), concatenated
params.checks: rot @ rot^T == I (3x3) and det(rot) == 1, per matrix, computed in float64
